_format: Version is major.minor.build.deploy. Newest release first. Add a new entry here for every deployment; the footer shows the first entry's version.

releases.title: First numbered release
notes: Version number and this release notes page added to the site footer.
Left navigation reordered: Word Lookup now sits above AI Translation, and Translation Game follows Article Analysis.

AI Translator: Helsinki-NLP models retrained on 45,000 Chuukese–English pairs, including sentences distilled from the larger MADLAD-400 model. Translations in both directions are markedly more accurate than the previous model.
Sentence and Article Analysis rebuilt on the Watchtower Online Library dictionary layer, with source lookup and saved analyses.
Translation Game: clues, glosses, phrase matching and saved-match colours.
Admin: translation review queue and dictionary de-duplication.
Training pipeline: memory-guarded local training, checkpoint resume, and retry on database throttling.
